properties.displayName: [AZ-05] Audit audit-relevant resources missing a diagnostic setting
properties.description: Lists Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts, Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults, Microsoft.Sql/servers and Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces that lack an attached diagnostic setting — the cross-resource absence check is reproduced against fixtures by run.py rather than expressed in a single-resource policy rule. Mirrors azure/arg/AZ-05.kql.
